title: Ultimate Georgetown Walking Tour: History, Politics, Culture
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step beyond the typical sightseeing route and uncover the hidden stories of Georgetown on this intimate guided walking tour. Explore one of Washington, D.C.’s most historic neighborhoods as you visit the famous Exorcist Steps, made iconic by the classic film, discover the former Kennedy family apartments, and stroll through the picturesque grounds of Georgetown University, one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in the United States. With a small-group atmosphere and expert local insights, you'll gain a deeper understanding of the people, landmarks, and events that shaped this charming waterfront district.
